name: Simon (Jesus' brother)
title: Jesus' brother
summary: Simon was one of Jesus' four brothers, sons of Joseph and Mary. He is mentioned together with his brothers James, Joses, and Judas in the Gospels, where it appears that Jesus' family initially did not believe in him as the Messiah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as Jesus' brother in Nazareth
keyEvents.description: When Jesus taught in the synagogue of his hometown, the people asked if this was not the carpenter's son, and mentioned his brothers James, Joseph, Simon, and Judas.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Gospel of Mark
keyEvents.description: Mark also confirms that Simon was one of Jesus' brothers when Jesus was rejected in his hometown of Nazareth.

keyEvents.title: Jesus' brothers did not believe in him
keyEvents.description: John tells us that Jesus' brothers did not believe in him during his earthly ministry, even though they later came to faith.

keyEvents.title: Gathered with the apostles after the ascension
keyEvents.description: After Jesus' ascension, his brothers were gathered in prayer with the apostles and other believers in Jerusalem, indicating that they had come to faith.
